description: FUNCTION STANDARD-COMPARE (ISO 15.85) - the cultural-ordering comparison returning the single character "<", "=" or ">" (15.85.4 r6/r7) over the ordering table an ORDER TABLE ordering-name identifies or, absent one, the default table 'ISO 14651_2020_TABLE1' (15.85.3 r5). LIVE (kb/Work PB101 T7): CobolIntrinsics.StandardCompare over the CLDR/UCA collation engine generated from Unicode CLDR/UCA data (src/WiseOwl.Cobol.Runtime/Collation/), argument-4's four ordering levels (15.85.4 r1/r2) and the 15.85.4 r4 trailing-space rule. A COBOL-2002 introduction, with the ORDER TABLE clause it depends on (VCR row 7.19). THE EDGE IS QUOTED from the edition texts (kb/Work PB3965): the 1985 intrinsic functions (Amendment 1, §1989:A.2.4 Table 1) run SQRT, STANDARD-DEVIATION ('| SQRT | N1 | N | Square root of N1 |', '| STANDARD-DEVIATION | N1 ... | N | Standard deviation of arguments |') with no STANDARD-COMPARE, and no 1985 clause names an ordering table (ORDER is a 1985 reserved word, §1985:IV.8 '| ORDER | REMAINDER | SPECIAL-NAMES | USE |', for WITH DUPLICATES IN ORDER); §2002:15.69 reads 'The STANDARD-COMPARE function returns a character indicating the result of comparing argument-1 and argument-2 using a culturally-sensitive ordering table constructed in compliance with ISO/IEC 14651:2001', §2002:12.2.6.1 prints '[ ORDER TABLE ordering-name-1 IS literal-9 ]' in the SPECIAL-NAMES format, §2002:F.2 states the change, its item 78 ('Intrinsic functions. New intrinsic functions are:', STANDARD-COMPARE among them) with item 42's cultural support ('Features supported are collating sequences, date and time formats'), and §2002:B.3 item 8 ties the two together: 'The STANDARD-COMPARE intrinsic function and the ORDER TABLE clause in SPECIAL-NAMES are dependent upon an implementation of ISO/IEC 14651:2001'. §2014:15.79 and §2014:12.3.6.1 carry both, so 2014 = 2023. Below 2002 the D8 catalog window rejects by name+edition (COBOL1502) - the window is now enforced rather than suppressed, because the row's Bind is no longer Unsupported.
vcr: 2002 introduction (§2002:15.69; §2002:F.2 item 78; with the ORDER TABLE clause, §2002:12.2.6.1); VCR row 7.19
